messages:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a 'staggered validation' flow for model intake: three phased gates (fast-smoke, profile-sampler, golden-sweep). Goal is to catch runtime/compat issues early without making deep-bench the default blocker. PTAL :thinking:

 tom: short q — what are the latency & cost targets for each gate?

 maria: smoke target: ~200ms median per smoke-run, wall timeout 200s for the whole smoke phase, smoke uses ~8 curated prompts + basic tokenization parity + kv-cache sanity. sampler: ~1k samples pulled from stratified production-ish distribution, budgeted to X GPU-mins. sweep: full golden suite (nightly or on-demand) for final signoff.

 ashok: concern: quantized variants often show tiny logit shifts that can trip parity checks. if smoke is too strict we'll delay lots of models. Suggest: soft-fail semantics and probation windows instead of hard block for small diffs.

 maria: agree on soft-fail idea. proposal: thresholds per family. tok mismatch <1% => soft-accept with note, 1-5% => probation + recompute on larger sample, >5% => block. Also attach minimal runtime fingerprint (ops used, tensor shapes) for hard incompat checks.

 maria: config sketch:

 ```yaml
 phases:
   - name: smoke
     timeout_ms: 200000
     checks: [liveness, tok_parity, kv_sanity]
   - name: sampler
     size: 1000
     checks: [perf, mem, correctness_signals]
   - name: sweep
     checks: [golden_accuracy, latency_tail, regression]
 ```

 eva: can we run the smoke gate as a hot-shadow route (no blocking) and only block on sampler/sweep? UX-wise it avoids noisy blocks while surfacing issues. also we should have an auto-canary rollout option with rollback policy.

 tom: telemetry needs: per-model counters, run_id, sample-level diffs, and a cost estimate for each phase (so product can reason about cadence). Also add a quick re-run hook in console.

 benchbot: benchbot: smoke-run for model 'luna-7b-quant-v2' finished — liveness ok, tok_mismatch=0.3%, median_latency=140ms, kv_stress=warn (p95 memory spike). Link: https://ci/bench/4250001122/summary

 maria: based on benchbot result: tok_mismatch 0.3% => soft-accept. kv_stress warn => add 'kv probation' tag and require a sampler follow-up. Suggest default action: soft-accept + enqueue sampler job.

 ashok: also insist on a runtime-abi fingerprint check: if model uses ops unsupported by target runtime or tensor shapes differ we hard-fail. That avoids subtle correctness vs perf mismatches later.

 eva: Console UX: show 'staggered status' with phases and failing examples + single-click re-run + explainers for thresholds. For canary, show traffic %, health, and auto-rollback button.

 maria: next steps: I'll update the doc https://redwood-internal/docs/staggered-validation with the config sketch, add a feature-flagged PR to the intake repo to land smoke configs, and add per-model telemetry tags. If no objections I'll schedule a 30m sync to iron out thresholds.

 tom: :thumbsup: no objections. please put smoke behind FF and add a small opt-out for teams to skip sampler for quick iteration.

 maria: will do. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
